map_rendering_root_cause_and_fix.real_browser_verification: PASSED -- the project owner independently opened http://localhost:3002/fifteen-minute in their own real desktop browser after the fix and confirmed the MapLibre map now renders correctly. This is NOT listed as a remaining product limitation.
map_rendering_root_cause_and_fix.summary: A real bug (confirmed by the project owner in their own real browser, not a test-tool artifact as first suspected) prevented the MapLibre basemap from ever finishing its load: MapLibre 6.x loads a separate worker script file (maplibre-gl-worker.mjs) via a runtime-computed import.meta.url-relative path, which Next.js's webpack build could not statically detect and therefore never emitted into the build output -- so the Worker was constructed against a URL serving nothing, and every tile-load request was dispatched into the void with no response and no error.
map_rendering_root_cause_and_fix.fix: Copied maplibre-gl-worker.mjs and its own dependency maplibre-gl-shared.mjs into public/ (a stable, webpack-untouched location), and called MapLibre's own documented setWorkerUrl() API in components/MapView.tsx before the first Map is constructed. Automated via a new npm run sync-maplibre-worker script wired into postinstall so this survives a fresh install or a maplibre-gl version bump.
